build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter-to-index mapping
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_word_decomposition: compose a word graph with a lexicon graph to compute all possible word decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs for sequence alignment
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence-level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graphs and comparing forward scores
